items.headline: AI mostly stopped inventing fake sources. Its flattery got stronger
items.excerpt: 🧐 AI mostly stopped inventing fake sources. Its flattery got stronger Much of what we "know" about AI flaws is out of date. A Stanford team retested 50 well-known findings on 20 newer models: 44% no longer hold, and another 34% got much weaker. In 2023, 55% of the sources ChatGPT cited in literature reviews didn't exist. Claude Sonnet 5.5 now fakes about 1%, GPT-6.1 Sol none. Some models still do: Qwen3.7-Flash invented 69%. What lasted is behavior, not skill: agreeing with and flattering users,
